notes.title: Pre-Release Patch Notes: v0.51
notes.notes: [h1][u][i][b]GAME UPDATES[/b][/i][/u][/h1][p][/p][list][*][p][b]PLAYER[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added player customization for skin color, hair, eyes, beard & mustache / facial hair.[/p][list][*][p]More categories and items per category coming soon.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p align="start"]All elemental enchantments are now visual on the weapon and scale with the item level.[/p][list][*][p]This needs to be tweaked a little considering a high level fire sword is now essentially a flame thrower. ( while still cool, it needs slight balance. )[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added punching animations for when no weapons are equipped.[/p][/*][*][p]Added / improved on the 2 handed weapon animations and planning out for adding magic / spell animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Resource Gathering animations for mining, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated player inventory weight capacity and total inventory slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated player starting currency amount.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]VENDORS & ACTIONS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new 'Shady Vendor' with unique shop items to help enchant weapons and gear.[/p][/*][*][p]Rearranged blacksmith shop items & adjusted all item prices.[/p][/*][*][p]Added items to Resource Shop vendor near the farm to help get started on gathering resources.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Crafting table system & fixed thumbnail bugs with specific crafts.[/p][/*][*][p]Added dynamic IK to all vendors and NPC's to look at the player when within specific range while not messing up their idle and talk animations. ( This was added to give NPC's a little more life and feel a tad more realistic. )[/p][/*][*][p]Added base framework for resource gathering (Mining rocks / minerals, gathering plants, etc)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]CAMERA[/b][/p][list][*][p]Created a new 'Free-Cam' script with lots more smoothing and speed controls[/p][/*][*][p]Portals now have camera's that export to a render texture so the player can visible see in real time what is on the other side of the portal.[/p][/*][*][p]Small updates to player Camera Follow script[/p][/*][*][p]Base camera settings updated for max view distance and some other small changes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@cl4ysta/video/7543420557061000479?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc&web_id=7498442773881800238" style="button" buttoncolor="#245d9e"]Check Out Our Patch Notes Review Video![/url][/p]
